overtakeTargetCandidate.description: Historical key: session-initialized teammate/paired-entry vehicle pointer read by a race-session Overtaking gate.
static_evidence: AIDriverStructInit initializes this+0x45F8 by comparing the vehicle text field at +0x46B8 across active cars.
The 60-second live capture resolved 24 of 25 entries into 12 reciprocal pointer pairs; AIAbility also reads the partner's pit state through this field.
Overtaking_0042AF70 requires a supplied candidate to equal this pointer on one race-session continuation path.
limitations: It is not populated by the nearby-candidate scan and must not be labelled a current overtake target. The exact source-string label at +0x46B8 is less important than the confirmed paired-entry relationship.

teammateVehicle.description: Canonical name for the session-initialized teammate/paired-entry vehicle pointer.
static_evidence: AIDriverStructInit pairs active vehicles by their shared +0x46B8 identifier.
AIAbility reads this paired vehicle for pit-strategy logic.
Live evidence resolved 12 reciprocal pairs among 25 active entries.
limitations: The historical overtakeTargetCandidate alias remains only for compatibility with prior captures; use teammateVehicle for new analysis.

overtakeSideOffset.description: Lateral planner value read from the field written by Overtaking on one commit branch.
static_evidence: Overtaking writes +3.0 or -3.0 to this field after one committed-decision branch.
limitations: Live restarted-race samples reached approximately +/-12, proving the field has additional writers or state meanings. A non-zero value is not pass-left/pass-right intent.

newOvertakeTargetCandidate.description: Shared transient selected-steering-candidate pointer: written by Overtaking and by the pre-racing-line proximity/lapping scan.
static_evidence: Overtaking writes this+0x45FC after a non-zero pass decision and writes +/-3.0 to +0x4420.
OpponentProximityScanTeamRecognition writes this+0x45FC for a nearby lap-ahead vehicle in race state 7 and writes +/-2.5 to +0x4420.
limitations: A pointer transition alone is not a completed pass. Treat it as a transient steering-candidate selection only; a pass claim additionally needs exact +/-3.0, active race context, and later pit-free same-pair progress/standing evidence. Exact writes can select either teammates or non-teammates, depending on race state. A named Monza join showed the source can subsequently lose the standing, so this field does not establish source-to-target pass direction.

trafficSpeedCap.description: Composite per-frame AI speed ceiling reset before planning, lowered by traffic logic in AISteering and by the separate max-speed restriction before AISteeringCorrection modulates throttle, coasts, or brakes.
static_evidence: AIMainUpdate resets vehicle+0x4484 to the 999999 sentinel immediately before AIRacingLine and AISteering.
TrackParameterMinimumClamp_0042A740 only lowers +0x4484 to its supplied ceiling with a 5.0 floor; AISteering calls it from candidate-traffic branches.
AISteeringCorrection also clamps +0x4484 against vehicle+0x4538, the independently commanded max-speed restriction.

AISteeringCorrection compares Speed (+0x4440) with +0x4484: a positive deficit through 1 modulates throttle, over 1 through 3 commands coasting, over 3 through 10 adds partial braking, and over 10 adds full braking.
limitations: A +0x4484 observation alone cannot distinguish an AISteering traffic clamp from the +0x4538 max-speed restriction; capture both on one clock.
The individual AISteering branch that supplied a particular traffic ceiling still requires same-clock candidate-state correlation.
This is a safety-critical command input and observation does not authorize writing it.

maxSpeedRestriction.description: Independent AI maximum-speed restriction folded into the composite +0x4484 ceiling by AISteeringCorrection.
static_evidence: AIDriverStructInit initializes vehicle+0x4538 to the 999999 sentinel.
ParameterValueSetter_0042ACD0 writes an externally commanded ceiling to +0x4538.
AISteeringCorrection passes +0x4538 through TrackParameterMinimumClamp before applying the +0x4484 response bands.
limitations: This field can represent race-control or another externally commanded speed restriction; its complete writer set and state mapping are not yet reviewed.
Observation does not authorize writing it.

aiIncidentPairQueue.description: Bounded direct read of the commentary controller's 20-record queue, filtered to collision/proximity tracker variants 225/226.
static_evidence: CollisionDetectionSystem calls OvertakingEventTracker, which emits 225 or 226 after its cooldown and geometry gate.
InsertDriverTableEntry retains twenty 0x20-byte records at controller+0x864.
Tracker pair identities survive in each record at +0x10 and +0x14.
limitations: Read-only capture detects retained queue changes; a later event may evict an earlier record before sampling.
These events are not lane-commit or completed-pass proof.

aiIncident225Timestamp.description: Read-only dispatch timestamp for the positive-noise collision/proximity variant (event 225).
static_evidence: OvertakingEventTracker emits 225 when its sampled noise-table value is positive, ordering the pair by projected track distance.
The controller has independently live-validated per-event timestamps at +0xAF8; 0xAF8 + 225*4 = 0xE7C.
limitations: A timestamp change proves controller dispatch only. The two involved AI drivers cannot be identified from this field alone, and the event is not proof of a pass.

aiIncident226Timestamp.description: Read-only dispatch timestamp for the non-positive-noise collision/proximity variant (event 226).
static_evidence: OvertakingEventTracker emits 226 when its sampled noise-table value is non-positive, reversing the projected-distance pair order used by 225.
The controller has independently live-validated per-event timestamps at +0xAF8; 0xAF8 + 226*4 = 0xE80.
limitations: A timestamp change proves controller dispatch only. The two involved AI drivers cannot be identified from this field alone, and the event is not proof of a pass.
